message.content:
**Compound‑interest calculation**

| Assumption | Formula | Result |
|------------|---------|--------|
| **Annual compounding** | \(A=P(1+r)^t\) | \(A=10\,000\times(1+0.05)^3=10\,000\times1.157625= \$11\,576.25\) |
| **Monthly compounding** | \(A=P\left(1+\frac{r}{12}\right)^{12t}\) | \(A=10\,000\times\left(1+\frac{0.05}{12}\right)^{36}=10\,000\times1.1616\approx \$11\,616.00\) |

- **Interest earned**  
  - Annual compounding: \(\$11\,576.25-\$10\,000=\$1\,576.25\)  
  - Monthly compounding: \(\$11\,616.00-\$10\,000=\$1\,616.00\)

So after 3 years you’ll have roughly **\$11.58 k** (annual compounding) or **\$11.62 k** (monthly compounding), earning about **\$1.58 k** or **\$1.62 k** in interest respectively.
